evidence_basis: Rhea; BRENDA; PathBank; MetaNetX enzyme reactions with EC labels
coverage_signal: All seven EC classes; reaction SMILES plus EC; reported data-driven biocatalysis model
usable_for_negative_samples: limited; use non-matching generated products only as hard decoys not true negatives
caveat: Not gut-specific and not food-specific; product labels are enzyme-catalysis facts, not gut occurrence facts
next_action: Map ECREACT reactions to food-gut compounds by InChIKey and EC, then require Rhea/BRENDA/PMID provenance before training

evidence_basis: MetaNetX; Rhea; USPTO; UniProt sequence support; reaction SMARTS templates
coverage_signal: 1,174,216 templates from 92,698 source reactions; EC coverage to fourth level
usable_for_positive_samples: not_directly; templates need matching source reaction and compound provenance
caveat: Templates are candidate-generation rules, not proof that a gut microbe performs the reaction on a food substrate
next_action: Import only templates with retained source reaction, EC, dataset, radius, and round-trip regeneration evidence

evidence_basis: Uses mono-component RetroRules SMARTS and explicit Rule_ID/Reaction_ID/EC fields
coverage_signal: Shows accepted schema for biochemical rule search and similarity-guided rule application
caveat: A pathway-search system, not a gut microbiome evidence database
next_action: Adopt its rule provenance fields for our rule manifest and scoring audit

evidence_basis: MNXref; MetaCyc; ModelSEED; KEGG; BRENDA; UniProt; TCDB; BiGG
coverage_signal: Genome/pathway/reaction database integration and gap filling for bacterial models
usable_for_positive_samples: yes_if_exact_reaction_maps_to curated source and gut organism context
usable_for_negative_samples: possible_network_negatives only when model evidence says reaction absent under defined organism/model
caveat: Genome-scale model absence is not a universal biochemical negative
next_action: Use as organism-level plausibility and external database cross-check, not as direct substrate-product predictor

evidence_basis: Curated known gut metabolic gene clusters; anaerobic gut bacteria focus
coverage_signal: Predicts known and novel specialized primary metabolic gene clusters
usable_for_positive_samples: yes_for_family_prioritization when cluster-product literature supports exact reaction
usable_for_negative_samples: no_direct_negatives; absence of cluster is not absence of reaction
caveat: Gene cluster prediction does not directly yield exact substrate-product pairs
next_action: Use to prioritize SCFA, aromatic, bile/steroid, and anaerobic energy families for external validation panels

evidence_basis: 3,457 enzyme substrates; 363,872 enzymes from about 690 gut bacterial strains
coverage_signal: Predicts EC class/subclass/complete EC and reaction centers for biotic/xenobiotic molecules
usable_for_positive_samples: maybe; only if underlying known substrate-reaction evidence is accessible and exact product is verified
usable_for_negative_samples: possible_hard_decoys from predicted off-target EC/classes, but not true negatives
caveat: Published tool notes EC/reaction center prediction; product-level evidence may still be missing
next_action: Use as external benchmark for reaction class coverage, not as unverified positive-label generator

evidence_basis: Over 600 compounds from more than 80 publications; 329 known HGM-metabolized compounds
coverage_signal: Predicts whether HGM metabolizes compound, bacterial genera, and biotransformation reaction classes
usable_for_negative_samples: yes_for compound-level depleted/not-metabolized challenge labels only with publication support
caveat: Drug-like scope and SAR labels do not directly define food-derived metabolite products
next_action: Use as external challenge set for HGM metabolism susceptibility, not core food-gut training

evidence_basis: KEGG orthologs; BioCyc reactions; taxon-specific metabolic models; microbiome-metabolome integration
coverage_signal: Predict metabolite generation/depletion potential from microbiome profiles
usable_for_positive_samples: no_for_exact_substrate_product unless mapped back to source reaction
usable_for_negative_samples: yes_for_unlabeled_or_contextual_negatives under defined community model, not hard chemical negatives
caveat: Presence/depletion predictions depend on reference quality and in vivo regulation
next_action: Use for negative-sampling logic: distinguish hard decoy, unlabeled, organism-absent, and context-absent labels
